checks.finding: Met object 437881 accession 89.15.21, Johannes Vermeer ca.1662, 45.7 × 40.6 cm oil on canvas. Museum acquired by Marquand gift in 1889; Met Japanese overview states one of first 13 Vermeer pictures to arrive in USA 1887–1919, not 1889 arrival.

Distinguish symbolic art-historical reading from creator's direct statement.
